details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) highlights a significant shift in the international system towards "strategic interdependence" and "geoeconomics," where economic tools serve geopolitical goals. This breakdown of the rules-based multilateral order, partly due to major economies like the US re-evaluating its benefits, is leading to economic pain and protectionist policies, affecting trade and investment globally.
title: IMF: Geopolitical Shifts Redefine Global Economy

details: Renewed military exchanges between the United States and Iran have significantly driven up oil prices, with Brent crude reaching over $96 a barrel. US diesel prices hit a record high of $5.85 per gallon. This escalation in the seven-month conflict intensifies fears of supply disruptions through the critical Strait of Hormuz, global inflation, and a potential pullback in economic growth. This scenario is bolstering the case for the US Federal Reserve to consider further interest rate hikes.
title: US-Iran Conflict Escalates, Oil Prices Surge to New Highs

details: House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries criticized President Donald Trump's economic policies, labeling the current economic situation a "Trump Slump." He highlighted concerns over persistent inflation, the rising cost of living, and the impact of tariffs, arguing that Trump's agenda is failing American citizens as the midterm elections intensify.
title: Democratic Leader Mocks Trump's Economic Policies Amid Inflation Concerns
